WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM jaffle_shop.dev.customers AS c
  JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
)
SELECT customer_id, customer_name, order_count
FROM customer_orders
WHERE order_count = (SELECT MAX(order_count) FROM customer_orders)
ORDER BY customer_name, customer_id
LIMIT 500
